2. The short fact relevant for disposal of this Rule is that the petitioner purchased the house in question by two agreements dated 28-7-1968 and 6-2-1970 from one Mostafa Ashraf who was an allottee from the them Government of East Pakistan in 1960. Immediately after part payment against above two agreements, the petitioner was put into possession of the said house in question in part performance of the said Agreements. Thereafter, Mr Mostafa Ashraf did not register the Deed of Sale in favour of the petitioner. Then the petitioner had to file a suit for Specific Performance of Contract being Title Suit No. 12 of 1972 in which Government of Bangladesh represented by the Deputy Commissioner (Dhaka) was impleaded as Defendant No. 2. The petitioner got a decree for registration of deed of sale through court and in Execution Case No. 28 of 1980 the said deed of sale was registered on 15-8-1981 in favour of the petitioner. While the petitioner was in peaceful possession of the said property from 1968 vide 1st Agreement dated 28-7-1968 and after registration of the sale deed in 1981 through decree of the Civil Court surprisingly the said property was enlisted in 'Ka' list as abandoned property in 1986, under the Abandoned property ordinance No. 16 of 1972. The petitioner challenged the said illegal enlistments of the property of 'Ka' list under the provisions of law before the court of Settlement by filing case No. 346 of 1989. After hearing both parties the case has been disposed of with the following direction. 

 "The respondent No. 2 made the prayer for exclusion of the case property from 'Ka' list not on the basis of decree which he obtained in the suit for Specific performance of Contract but on the basis of the deeds of agreement and claimed that he had been in possession before promulgation of president order No. 16 of 1972. When his possession in the case property has been proved on the basis of the Deeds of Agreement, the last one being executed in February, 1970 there is no scope of enlisting the case property in the 'Ka' list as abandoned property. We find no infirmity in the judgment and order Passed by the Court of Settlement or by High Court Division in the Writ petition No. 1370 of 1994. In the result, the appeal is dismissed without any order as to cost.
